verdict.rationale: Statsig publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for its Console API at api.statsig.com/openapi/20240601.json, and its docs link the spec and commit to keeping it up to date. The probe's 404s on docs.statsig.com paths cover a different host, so they do not contradict this. missing for 10: no evidenced machine-readable spec for the HTTP evaluation/events API (only the Console API), no independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: api.statsig.com publishes the Console API's machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the versioned path /openapi/20240601.json
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
